integrity: The analytic proof supplies the infinite-dimensional-in-time conclusions; the finite computer checks are consistency tests, not a proof of all trajectories. No independent verification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only three identical-frequency oscillators, a single symmetric triadic sine interaction of positive strength, and the phase-difference torus; no claim for perturbed models, stochastic forcing or absolute historical priority.
title: Exact Morse–Smale portrait and equal basin areas for a purely triadic oscillator triangle
